lines.en: label ayanespecial55:
scene ayanegamenight1
: Oh! Oh! What is the “echidna!”
: What is the echidna? It sounds made up.
: Apparently, it is an egg-laying mammal without teeth. As for why Ayane knows that, I have no idea. But she’s gotten more than half of these questions correct so far, so I’m not exactly surprised.
It’s another Saturday night at my place. And for the first time in what feels like forever, the three girls I hold closest to my heart are together and bonding.
And I use the word “bonding” loosely because the majority of the night has consisted of them shouting words at my television and keeping the neighbors that I probably have awake.
Come to think of it, it’s a little strange that I’ve never once interacted with anyone in any of the surrounding houses. But I guess it’s probably better off that way.
The fewer people I know, the better.

Unless, of course, those people are attractive (And likely pubescent) teenage girls who dream of riding my penis. But, I repeat, I’m probably better off not knowing them for reasons I’m sure you can understand.
As for these ones, though...I’m glad I do know them.
Knowing Ami is inevitable given our blood relation and whatnot. But I can’t even fathom what life without Maya or Ayane would be like.
On one hand, I’d have a lot more free time — and I’d never have to worry about things like the size of the moon or where to put my hands when hugging on a rooftop.
But, on the other, I’d lack the household harem that has provided me so much comfort when you strip away all of the anguish that rides in on their shoulders.
I am home. In more ways than one.
And I intend to stay here for as long as I can.
Because these days, while uncertain and burdensome-
Are the best days I have ever had.
Praise be.
scene ayanegamenight2
: Can we maybe play something else soon? I’m starting to get a little tired of Ayane’s weird internal bank of useless knowledge.

: It clearly isn’t useless if it’s coming in handy tonight, right? Without my weird internal bank thingy, we’d just be watching some old guy on the TV ask a bunch of questions none of us know the answers to.
: What is “Sirius.”
scene ayanegamenight3
: Like the radio? What was the question? I might have actually known that one.
: This star, in Canis Majoris, is the brightest in the night sky.
: The heck does that have to do with the radio?
: Wow, Ami. You’re seriously bad at this game, aren’t you?
scene ayanegamenight4
: Get it? Like...Sirius.
: Okay. I’m going to sleep.
: Yeah, I think I’ve also reached my horrible joke limit for the night. And every single one of them just so happened to come from Ayane.
: Don’t hate the player, Maya. Hate the game.
: I hate the game. We’re playing Wii Sports next sleepover and I don’t care what anyone says.
scene ayanegamenight5
: But, on that note, I guess it’s time we take baths. It’s getting pretty late anyway.
: I feel like that’s a thing we should have done before putting our pajamas on. This was not an effective order of operations.
: You two can go ahead. I’ll hang out here with Sensei in the meantime and finish up Jeopardy with him.
scene ayanegamenight6
: Oh! Instead of that, how about I-
: Nope! You can go on ahead, Ami. I’m perfectly capable of hanging out in the living room without making love to your uncle. I’ve been doing it for years.
Huh.
Come to think of it, I guess we haven’t had sex in the living room yet.
scene ayanegamenight7
: Uhh...
: You do know that all three of us should be able to- never mind. I just realized what’s going on here. But good luck getting Ami to agree to-
scene ayanegamenight8
: Hah...fine.
: Wait, seriously? You’re not going to, like...sew your skin to Sensei’s or tie him up and drag him into the bathroom with us?
: No...I’m pretty sure those things fall under “suffocating” and I told Sensei I’d be good from now on. Let’s just go take our stupid bath without Ayane.
: What the fuck is going on tonight?
: What’s going on is Ami is learning to be less clingy and we should all be very proud of her! Hooray for Ami!
scene black
: Hooray my butt! You know darn well I’m doing this against my will. Come on, Maya.
: You don’t have, like...surveillance cameras anywhere, do you? Because I can’t imagine any other reason you’d so easily accept-
: I said come on!
: Jesus, chill. The bath’s not even warm yet.
: Sensei! Couch!
scene ayanegamenight9
Ami and Maya head into the bathroom and, in between wondering why it’s totally normal for girls to do things like this, I find a moment to savor this newfound peace and quiet.
But that’s not without the mildly worrying caveat that there must have been some sort of catalyst needed to get here.
I know Ami better than anyone. Even more so than Maya and Ayane. So why is it that Ayane is suddenly able to seize me without any sort of repercussion?
This can’t just be the result of Ami actually taking my words to heart, can it?
I’ve said plenty of words to her since waking up in my own body again, and her heart has gone entirely unchanged up to this point in time.
Maybe she’s like me?
Finally changing.
Finally attempting to look forward instead of glancing over her shoulder every five seconds.
Or maybe it’s something else?
: Sensei...
All I know is that, whatever it is...might just be the single most worrying thing I’ve ever seen from my beloved niece.
Who would never hurt anyone.
: I missed you.
Who would never hurt anyone.
: I’m glad to be back.
Especially me.
: What do you mean by “back?” You haven’t gone anywhere.
scene ayanegamenight10
: Maybe not physically. But mentally, I’ve been in a pretty bad place for a while now. And I’m just starting to snap myself out of it.
: Things like that wouldn’t happen if you’d stop being such a martyr, you know.
: Martyrs die. And I’m not going anywhere ever again.
: None of us are. None of us can. What I meant is that you’d have less mental voyages if you’d get better at talking about your problems.
scene ayanegamenight11
: That’s really funny. Coming from you, I mean.
: I’m aware that I could benefit from the same thing. I’m just too caught up in my ways at this point.
: You and Maya both. Kudos to me for being the mature and logical one in the group. I bet nobody saw that coming.
: Careful or Makoto might gun for your position. I’m pretty sure her biggest fetish is logic.
: Do you think she’ll still be “around” after the next reset? Or do you think she’ll go back to not knowing how any of this stuff works?
: None of us know how any of this stuff works. Which includes me not having any clue what will or won’t happen to Makoto.
: I’m just trying not to get my hopes up. I did that with Yumi and Tsuneyo and that didn’t pan out how any of us wanted. So expecting nothing will-
: Be the best way to avoid getting hurt. You’re right.
: I’m doing the same thing. Or...trying to, at least.
: The problem with hope is that it always finds its way in whether you want it to or not. And there’s no way any of us could be, like...immune to that.
scene ayanegamenight12
: You seem a little...reflective tonight. Did something happen?
: Of course something happened. I’m not nearly strong enough to break free from inner turmoil without something causing it.
: I don’t think you’re giving yourself enough credit, Ayane. You’re one of the strongest people I know.
: And I just got a whole lot stronger.
: Meaning...what, exactly?
scene ayanegamenight13

: Unfortunately, I promised I wouldn’t tell you. It’s nothing but good news, though. For me, definitely. And...for all of us, I think. But that last part is more of an expectation than actually knowing.
: So...you’re just going to tell me you had some intense inner struggle that you’ve now recovered from, but won’t provide any of the details and I have to just...go along with it?
: Yeah.
: Well, that’s fun.
scene ayanegamenight14
: Trust me when I say that hearing the details would just make things even more confusing. And that’s exactly what I’m trying to avoid right now.
: We’ve been looking at things all wrong. Worrying about how things work instead of why the world is like this.
: Do you know why the world is like this, Ayane?
scene ayanegamenight15
: What I know is that I love you.
: Everyone knows that. It’s not exactly a revelation.
: No. But it’ll be my crutch again as both of us begin a new chapter of our lives.
: And that chapter is what?
: One without fear.
: One where we come first and the world comes second.
: I have eternity to spend with you. That’s lifetimes and lifetimes worth of happiness and laughter and the backwards spider crawl.
: I still haven’t figured out what that is.
: Neither have I. But the point is that we can figure it out together.
: I’m not really sure what you’re saying, Ayane. Is this, like...a resignation from the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad?
: It sounds kind of weird hearing you call it that.
: It feels kind of weird saying it.
: Sensei, I’m not resigning from anything. And I’m honestly not sure if I even could.
: I’ll still be on that roof with you and Maya. And maybe Makoto. But it’ll be a better me.
: I’ll be an Ayane you can lean on.
: And I’ll protect you from anything and everything that would ever want to hurt you.
: Do you...know something that might want to hurt me?
scene ayanegamenight16
: Other than yourself? It’s hard to say. But...let me ask you this.
: What do you think of the way Ami’s been acting lately?
: Honestly?...
: It’s concerning.
scene ayanegamenight17
: Isn’t it? She seems all cute and cuddly on the outside, but she can be a real monster on the inside sometimes, can’t she?
: She’s doing it out of love, though.
: Is that what you actually think? Or is it something she’s just said so many times now that you can’t help but accept it as truth?
: It’s what I actually think. But a better question is what happened between you two where she’s suddenly no longer combative against your attempts to steal alone time with me?
: I did what any friend would do. I talked to her.
: I called her out on all of the things she does that piss me off and I told her I wouldn’t stand for them anymore.
: And she just...accepted that?
: Only time will tell.
: But I have a good feeling she did.
: And I have a good feeling she won’t be getting in the way of us as much as she used to.
scene ayanegamenight18
: Well...I hope you’re right. About everything.

: I’m not sure if I’ll be able to just stop worrying about stuff the way you have...but whatever it is that’s helped you feel better, whether that be your talk with Ami or anything else that may have happened...
: I’m glad.
: I missed the happier version of you.
: Same here. Life’s been on a constant downward spiral ever since that half-year stretch where we weren’t allowed to have sex. I’m glad things are finally turning around.
: And also, we should have sex.
: Like...Like now?
scene ayanegamenight19
: Don’t know. Think my new sway with Ami will get her to agree to the two of us taking a bath together next?
: I’m not sure if there’s anything in the world that could get her to agree to that...
scene black
: Neither am I.
: But just this is enough for now.
: Even if I know she hates it.
scene ayanegamenight20
: That gosh darn bubblewrap princess. She’s lucky I’m in such a good mood tonight.
: Question. Why are you in such a good mood tonight? That was the least...aggressive I’ve ever seen you when it comes to cock-blocking Sensei.
scene ayanegamenight21
: Don’t call it that. Calling it that makes it sound like the two of them are getting up to no good out there.
: For all we know, they are. They’re both insatiable. I wouldn’t put it past them.
scene ayanegamenight22
: Sensei is not insatiable. He’s just a pervert with unsophisticated taste. Or...sophisticated taste if it’s in relation to me. But it’s normally not, so...
: He’s just a pervert.
: If that’s what helps you sleep at night, Ami.
scene ayanegamenight23
: What about you, Maya?
: What about me?
: I mean...how do you feel about Ayane getting to spend alone time with Sensei while the two of us are stuck in here?
: Um...normal?
: You’re not even a little jealous?
: What would I have to be jealous of?
: The pervy stuff that might be happening.
scene ayanegamenight24
: I couldn’t be any less interested in that sort of thing if I tried.
: You can be honest with me, Maya. I won’t get mad. I’ve already accepted that everyone in our class is constantly fantasizing about Sensei because he’s the perfect man.
: You have an expectedly horrid definition of the word “perfect.”
: As long as it’s just fantasy, you can do whatever you want. It’s only when it becomes real that it’s a problem.
: You could even think of me if you want.
scene ayanegamenight25
: Okay, seriously, what is going on with you? You’ve been weird ever since we got back from the beach.
: And Ayane hasn’t?
: You both have. But Ayane hasn’t outright told me that she wouldn’t care if I sexually fantasized about her.
: It probably just hasn’t come up yet.
: And it probably won’t because it’s weird.
: It’s not that weird. What is weird is how sexually open our entire class seems to be despite all of us being teenage girls. Or how every single one of us is absolutely adorable.
: Or how our class has its own dorm building. Or how the weather suddenly isn’t as hot as it’s supposed to be.
scene ayanegamenight26
: Or how the sidewalk just ends and drops off into nothing sometimes, but no one ever says anything about it.
: There are millions of things we can see that we don’t speak of because it would ruin something bigger.
: Ami...what are-
: It’s only when it becomes real that it’s a problem. Right, Maya?
: Only when...
: What? I have no idea what you’re trying to-
: Just keep it all a fantasy...okay?
: Can you do that?
scene ayanegamenight27
: Could you let me go now? I’d kind of like to pay a visit to the other side of the bath.
: But I’ll get lonely if you’re gone.
: Then...get lonely. You’re weirding me out.
scene black
: Psht...fine. And here I was thinking we were about to have a cute bonding session.
: We can bond from opposite ends of the bath...
